text: The attached report presents the activities undertaken by Toronto Atmospheric Fund in keeping with the 2019 Business Plan, the outcomes achieved including on TAF's Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and reflections on challenges encountered and lessons learned.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received Toronto Atmospheric Fund's 2019 Business Report - Attachment 1 to the report (January 31, 2020) from the Vice President, Strategy and Partnerships, for information.
